subject: Report counters
notes: cite.py --check 8.4.3.15.4 "It is reset to 1 when a report group that contains a NEXT GROUP clause with a RESET phrase is printed" -> OK 2). INITIATE sets PageCounter = 1 (GR1c comment); PageFeed increments by 1 at every page advance; NEXT GROUP ... WITH RESET arms _resetPageCounterAtAdvance and the next PageFeed sets 1. The WHEN of the reset is a documented determination (docs/CONFORMANCE.md, PB957 block (1)) reconciling GR2 with §13.18.37.4 GR6 (--check 13.18.37.4 "immediately after the page feed caused by the next page advance" -> OK 6)) and §14.9.16.4 GR6 d) (--check -> OK 6) d)). Probe a2.cob: INIT PC=1; after overflow PC=2 (D); D2 NEXT GROUP NEXT PAGE WITH RESET -> PC still 2 (E, determination), next advance -> PC=1 (F); page headings print 01/02/01. Pinned by conformance:cases/8.4.3.15-Report-counters/pb957_next_group_forms (WITH RESET derivation) and conformance:cases/8.4.3.15-Report-counters/pb1001_line_next_page (+1 per advance).
